text:
alice: Heads up — since the midnight kernel roll on west-1, Prometheus scrape latency for node-exporter/agent DS jumped ~5-8x on ~120 nodes. Alerts firing: k8s/agent_scrape_latency_p95 > 2s. Anyone else seeing this?

ben: yep, saw it. From Prom graph it lines up with the rollout. p95 went 200ms -> 2.3s. heap use on prometheus replica increased too.

carla: quick diag: `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=node-exporter -o wide` shows many node-exporter pods reporting high container_cpu_usage_seconds_total on the same hosts. Could be new custom runtime collector.

dan: Confirmed. Our custom gpu-runtime-exporter (daemonset) started shipping per-process labels (pid, cmdline) in 0.7.1. That exploded label cardinality for /metrics scrape. See snippet from one host: ```gpu_runtime_process{pid="1234",cmdline="/opt/serve"} 1``` — there are thousands of unique pid values.

alice: That matches — prometheus is scraping both node-exporter and gpu-runtime-exporter on same nodes. Cardinality explosion increases scrape time + prom memory. Need quick mitigation.

carla: Short-term options: 1) Temp scale down scraper frequency for these targets; 2) Add scrape relabel to drop pid & cmdline labels; 3) Disable the custom collector via env var on DS.

ben: Prefer 2) or 3). 1) delays metrics for everything. We can hotfix Prom config with relabel_configs to drop labels. Example: ```relabel_configs:
  - action: labeldrop
    regex: 'pid|cmdline'```

dan: We can also push 0.7.2 within hours to stop emitting pid label by default. But rollout needs canary. I'll open PR. For immediate relief I'll patch the daemonset to set `EXPORTER_DISABLE_PROC_COLLECTOR=true`.

alice: SRE-oncall, can you hold paging and set alert threshold to 5s for the scraping alert until we mitigate? Noise is heavy.

sre-oncall: On it. Will silence the alert for `infra-west-1` for 30m and raise the threshold. Also adding a runbook link.

carla: Prom config snippet I'll push as emergency change if Dan can't patch DS immediately: ```scrape_configs:
- job_name: 'gpu-runtime'
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: pod
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ['__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app']
    regex: 'gpu-runtime'
    action: keep
  - action: labeldrop
    regex: 'pid|cmdline'```

emma-bot: deploy-bot: emergency prom config change deployed to staging in 30s (hash abc123).

ben: :thumbsup: Can we also add a Grafana panel to track unique label count per job? Will help detect similar regressions.

dan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gpu-runtime-exporter/pull/142 — removes pid label, keeps process_name. Rolling canary to 5 nodes in west-1 now.

alice: Plan: (1) oncall silence alerts (done), (2) apply relabel drop in prometheus ASAP, (3) patch DS env var as stop-gap, (4) roll PR 0.7.2 canary then fleet. I'll make a checklist in the incident channel.

ben: I'll follow up with cost note: prometheus memory spike added ~0.8 vCPU and ~6GB mem on prom replica during window, so could hit billing at scale. Add to postmortem.

carla: Thanks. If anyone needs the one-liner to check label cardinality: `curl -s http://localhost:9100/metrics | grep 'gpu_runtime_process' | wc -l`

sre-oncall: Alert silenced and threshold increased. Notifying pagers. Monitoring now.

alice: Closing loop: once PR is green and canary passes, remove emergency relabel to keep metrics full. Assigning dan+ben for rollout and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
